goal: Improve Stegosaurus atlas-scale recognition by making the dorsal row read more clearly as separate upright bony plates than the prior block-like plate-focused i2i candidate.

mustHave: smaller plates toward the neck and tail base
coherent side-profile body with one tail and four legs
rejectIf: tail-tip inpaint that does not create countable four-spike thagomizer

experiments.finding: Selected because the dorsal row reads more clearly as separate upright plates than the prior block-like i2i candidate while keeping the body mostly coherent.
Rejected because the narrow tail-tip inpaint did not create a clearly countable four-spike thagomizer.

decision.reason: Promoted as the app-first plate-recognition review candidate because the dorsal plates are easier to read than the previous first image.
remainingIssues: too few large rounded plates instead of many varied kite or diamond plates
needs Stegosaurus-specific plate and tail-spike model support before approval
decision.nextRoute: Use a focused stegosaurian plate/thagomizer LoRA or a synthetic seed/control set that forces both varied plate count and four tail spikes in the same generation pass.
